relations.subject: Chizen Akanuma
relations.evidence: a professor of Ōtani University who specialized in pre-sectarian Buddhism.

relations.subject: Chizen Akanuma
relations.evidence: He entered Shinshū University to study Buddhism.

relations.subject: Chizen Akanuma
relations.evidence: In 1909, he attended "Koukou do"(浩々洞), which was an association school built by Kiyozawa Manshi.

relations.subject: Chizen Akanuma
relations.evidence: After coming back to Japan, he was appointed professor of Shinshū University and lectured on pre-sectarian Buddhism and Pali language.

relations.subject: Chizen Akanuma
relations.evidence: Chizen and his colleagues, Daisetsu Suzuki and Gessyo Sasaki established "The Eastern Buddhist Society" to spread the essence of Buddhism to Western countries.
